title: Beyond the desk: Building a community in our Bulgarian office
summary: At our core, RingCentral Bulgaria is more than a workplace. We are a community in our own right. While our global mission is to help people connect all
body_markdown:
At our core, RingCentral Bulgaria is more than a workplace. We are a community in our own right. While our global mission is to help people connect all across the world, our local priority is building genuine, everyday connections right here in Sofia.


In August, we’ve created a few wonderful opportunities to step away from our screens, challenge ourselves, and celebrate together. Here is a look at how we’ve been connecting.


# Kudos Celebration


Peer recognition is at the heart of what we do. Our very own Kudos program encourages meaningful feedback and appreciation among team members. In August, we held a special event featuring delicious ice cream to congratulate the team members that consistently go out of their way to shout out their colleagues and recognize their hard work.


# Staying Active


For those looking for an adrenaline rush, our team took on the Legion Run — an exciting obstacle course that brought colleagues closer together as they tackled physical challenges side by side.


Nothing beats a friendly, energetic game of football to spark team spirit, get our hearts pumping, and share a few laughs outside of working hours.


# Unwinding Together


Our after-hours socials give us a casual way to kick back, share a cold drink, and unwind in great company after a productive week.


Whether we are sweating it out on an obstacle course, raising a glass during cocktail hour, or recognizing each other’s hard work, our Bulgarian office proves every day that work is much more than just a place you go — it’s the people you share it with.


# Join Our Community


Whether you’re here to learn something new, find inspiration, or connect with like-minded people, you’ve come to the right place. Discover your next career move with us:


[Careers web page](https://www.ringcentral.com/bg/en/careers.html) .


Originally published Sep 17, 2026
